i18n.zhSummary: 有关生成式人工智能信息泄露的文章经常引用海外案例。另一方面，日本公开了哪些案件、以何种形式公开？在这篇文章中，我们一一列举了2023年至2026年10月日本公布的涉及生成式人工智能的18起案件，一一由当事人公布，一则由媒体公布。
i18n.enTitle: Risks that can be prevented with internal rules and systems that can be prevented based on 18 cases of generated AI that have been published in Japan
i18n.enSummary: Articles about information leaks from generative AI often cite cases from overseas. On the other hand, what kinds of cases have been made public in Japan, and in what form? In this article, we identified 18 cases involving generative AI that were announced in Japan from 2023 to October 2026, one by one by the parties involved, and one by the media.
